tips_en: Start with Paper 2 (WMRL), as it tackles a broadly impactful scaling bottleneck with a novel world-model RL approach that also transfers to embodied VLA training on LIBERO-Long, creating a natural bridge to Paper 1's robotics focus. Read Paper 1 (LIT) next, since its elegant Latent Interface Training directly addresses a foundational robustness problem in the same VLA/WAM architectures Paper 2 fine-tunes. Save Paper 3 (SAS) for last—while its attention sparsification results are strong, it is more specialized to LLM inference efficiency and less thematically connected to the other two.
tips_zh: 建议优先阅读论文2（WMRL），它用一个新颖的世界模型强化学习框架解决了具有广泛影响的执行瓶颈问题，并且该方法还能迁移到LIBERO-Long上的具身VLA后训练，自然地桥接到论文1的机器人方向。接着读论文1（LIT），因为其优雅的潜在接口训练方法直接解决了与论文2相同的VLA/WAM架构中的基础鲁棒性问题。论文3（SAS）可以最后阅读——虽然其注意力稀疏化结果很强，但它更专注于LLM推理效率，与前两篇论文的主题关联较弱。
